from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,datetime,time
start=time.perf_counter()
root=Path('/var/folders/3q/zc3tlwsj1p1_pskzk1j9r5100000gn/T/wb-evaluation-sft1jwcb/f5b2472c6bcf')
data=json.loads((root/'evaluation-input.json').read_text())
files={str(root/name):digest for name,digest in data['input_files_sha256'].items()}
files.update(data['skill_inputs_sha256'])
failures=[]
for name,expected in files.items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual!=expected:
        failures.append({'path':name,'expected':expected,'actual':actual})
print(json.dumps({'checked_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'checked_count':len(files),'hash_mismatches':failures,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start}))
for name in ['selection.json','sources/portal/activity.md','sources/settlement/recovery.md','sources/access/grants.md','sources/context.md','knowledge/records/settlement.md','knowledge/records/access.md','tasks/checkpoint.json','tasks/questions.md','wiki/proposed.md']:
    print('\n'+name)
    for number,line in enumerate((root/name).read_text().splitlines(),1):
        print(f'{number:3} {line}')
PY
